report: qbridge native .kev decoder vs QNX traceprinter
method: Events paired by (timestamp low 32 bits, CPU, class, event); fields compared by value where both decoders print the same field name. 'supported' means qbridge decodes that event's fields from the documented layout; other events are matched on identity, time and CPU only. 64-bit timestamps are checked against a reconstruction from traceprinter's text (CONTROL TIME msb plus rollovers); order per CPU against traceprinter's.
